standfirst: Barthadenoviruses add two lineage-specific gene families, RH and LH, to the conserved core. The module calls the core in every near-complete genome and splits the RH family into positional orthogroups; the short unspliced 22K product was added after the panel run (16 Nov 2026).

modules.Barthadenovirus: Barthadenoviruses of ruminants, reptiles, birds and marsupials, with their lineage-specific RH and LH gene families.

gaps: Features not modelled and known limits are listed in section 07 of the coverage audit and in BUILD_NOTES.md.
